fomod.Name: Lost Art of Spellmaking
fomod.Author: Lost Art of Spellmaking contributors
fomod.Description:
Morrowind's complete spellmaker for Skyrim SE/AE: every rule, limit, formula and effect of the original, used at an Altar of Spellmaking or bought from NPC spellmakers.
Requirements: SKSE64 matching your game build, Address Library for SKSE Plugins, SkyUI, MCM Helper. Recommended: SSE Engine Fixes. Supported: Skyrim SE 1.5.97 and AE 1.6.x (Steam and GOG).
Every behavior choice is a runtime MCM setting; nothing needs reinstalling to change one. To uninstall, run Maintenance > Prepare for uninstall in the MCM first, then save and remove the mod.
